import unittest
from copy import deepcopy

from solution import order_entries


class OrderEntriesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.entries = [
            {"rank": 2, "name": "a", "nested": {"items": [1]}},
            {"rank": 1, "name": "b", "nested": {"items": [2]}},
            {"rank": 2, "name": "c", "nested": {"items": [3]}},
        ]

    def test_low_is_stable_and_deep_copied(self):
        original = deepcopy(self.entries)
        result = order_entries(self.entries, "low")
        self.assertEqual([item["name"] for item in result], ["b", "a", "c"])
        self.assertEqual(self.entries, original)
        source_by_name = {item["name"]: item for item in self.entries}
        for item in result:
            source = source_by_name[item["name"]]
            self.assertIsNot(item, source)
            self.assertIsNot(item["nested"], source["nested"])
            self.assertIsNot(item["nested"]["items"], source["nested"]["items"])

    def test_high_is_stable(self):
        result = order_entries(self.entries, "high")
        self.assertEqual([item["name"] for item in result], ["a", "c", "b"])

    def test_keep_retains_order_but_not_aliases(self):
        result = order_entries(self.entries, "keep")
        self.assertEqual(result, self.entries)
        self.assertIsNot(result, self.entries)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0], self.entries[0])
        result[0]["nested"]["items"].append(9)
        self.assertEqual(self.entries[0]["nested"]["items"], [1])

    def test_empty_and_policy_validation(self):
        result = order_entries([], "keep")
        self.assertEqual(result, [])
        self.assertIsInstance(result, list)
        for policy in ("LOW", "", None, 1):
            with self.subTest(policy=policy):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "^invalid policy$"):
                    order_entries([], policy)

    def test_invalid_entries(self):
        invalid = [None, {}, [1], [{"rank": True}], [{"rank": 1.0}], [{"x": 1}]]
        for entries in invalid:
            with self.subTest(entries=entries):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "^invalid entries$"):
                    order_entries(entries, "low")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
